purpose: Concrete package pin for the LangGraph/LangChain agent-middleware capability probe (R0/M0). 'Pin' means this experiment is tied to these exact package versions, not to version ranges or dist-tags.
install_command: python -m venv <venv> && <venv>/Scripts/python -m pip install langchain langgraph
notes: Installed fresh from PyPI on 2026-08-25 with no constraints; resolved versions above were recorded post-install from pip freeze (full freeze captured in each run's report.json env.full_freeze).
If any langchain*/langgraph* version drifts from this pin, the capability matrix must be re-run under the new versions before its cells are trusted.
The probe uses a scripted offline chat model (no network, no provider keys); interception behavior under test lives in the agent/middleware layer, not the model.
